name: Dynamic Topology Evolution
aliases: Dynamic Topology Evolution — Bulk-synchronous topology evolution, NanoVDB dynamic topology updates
definition: A bulk-synchronous model for evolving the topological domain of active voxels in a NanoVDB sparse grid, consisting of three steps: (a) collective decision of topology changes, (b) bulk materialization of changes into a new valid topology/data state, and (c) resumption of computation on the new epoch.
summary: Dynamic Topology Evolution is a bulk-synchronous GPU method that enables efficient topological changes on NanoVDB grids using linearized memory and bit-parallel algorithms, unlike OpenVDB's pointer-heavy approach.
